title: Vercel Pro to self-hosted Dokploy
summary: Dokploy is the lighter of the two self-hosted platform-as-a-service options here. The seat price is still only half the story.

you_lose: Vercel's edge network, which one VPS does not replicate at any price
Automatic image optimisation and instant cache invalidation
Zero-config Next.js behaviour that exists because Vercel builds both halves
Preview deployments that cost nothing when idle
you_gain: A fixed bill instead of usage billing that can spike without warning
Free seats, including for people who only need to read logs
Any runtime, not only the supported ones

caveats: Latency-sensitive global traffic is the case where this loses regardless of price. Put a CDN in front of it or stay on Vercel.
The $20 per seat excludes usage overages. If bandwidth is why you are here, your Vercel bill is higher than this page assumes and Dokploy wins sooner.
Dokploy is younger than Coolify with a smaller community. That is a real operational risk on the box that runs your production apps.
